annotations.title: Multi-country itinerary check: visas per leg, Schengen 90/180 count, apply-by dates, passport validity (up to 6 legs)

description: Use when a traveller visits several countries on one trip: give passport and legs in order (COUNTRY:YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD, comma-separated, up to 6) and get per leg the visa rule with an over-stay check, US/UK advice, holidays and FX; across the trip the Schengen 90/180 count over every Schengen leg (add earlier stays in schengen_history), where and when to apply for a Schengen visa, apply-by dates for ETAs / e-Visas / embassy visas, passport validity at every border, itinerary problems (overlaps, gaps, re-entries) and one ordered checklist. Optional: passport, legs, passport_expiry, schengen_history, home_currency. PAID: $0.500 per call, no API key or account, or free with a Trip Desk Pass. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base) or MPP over MCP (USDC.e on Tempo); an unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing. Bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/itinerary-check.

home_currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the FX lines. Default: the passport country's currency

legs.description: Legs in travel order, comma-separated, each COUNTRY:ARRIVE:LEAVE (YYYY-MM-DD; LEAVE optional = next leg's arrival). Up to 6. Default (bare call): United Kingdom, France, Italy starting 30 days from today

pass.description: Optional Trip Desk Pass token (tp1....). With a valid pass this call is not charged. Prefer setting it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>.

passport.description: Traveller nationality: ISO alpha-2/alpha-3 or English name. Default (bare call): US

passport_expiry.description: Optional passport expiry YYYY-MM-DD: checked at every border

schengen_history.description: Optional earlier Schengen stays FROM:TO (YYYY-MM-DD), comma-separated, up to 10: counted in the 90/180 window

name: itinerary_check
